_comment: Generated by injury_lab/signals.py. Pilot figures are counts over the six completed fixtures in this repository whose date and club codes match a retained official capture; they are not evidence about any rule, and reward_eligible is hard-coded False while IG3 fails for the whole family.

gate_register.name: Provenance
gate_register.threshold: every input row traces to a retained official capture or to the hashed pinned dataset

gate_register.name: Causality
gate_register.threshold: the signal must be computable from a report published before the price used to settle it

gate_register.name: Sample size
gate_register.threshold: bets >= 300, seasons >= 8, holdout bets >= 40, confirmation-window bets >= 100
gate_register.register: stricter of docs/preregistration.md G3 (300 / 8 / 40) and scripts/gates.py G1 (200 / 100)

gate_register.name: Both-window direction
gate_register.threshold: ROI > 0 in the discovery window (2000-2015) and in the confirmation window (2016-2026)

gate_register.name: Multiplicity
gate_register.threshold: Benjamini-Hochberg q <= 0.10 across every rule this repository has tested, not this family alone
gate_register.register: scripts/gates.py G4 with family_size from data/derived/gates_meta.json

gate_register.name: Season concentration
gate_register.threshold: no season > 50% of profit and >= 60% of seasons positive
gate_register.register: stricter of scripts/gates.py G5 (>=50% seasons positive) and docs/preregistration.md G7 (>=60%)

gate_register.name: Price stress
gate_register.threshold: still positive when every bet is re-priced at -115

gate_register.name: Second line source
gate_register.threshold: still positive scored against the second in-dataset line source

gate_register.name: Luck-adjusted edge
gate_register.threshold: empirical-Bayes shrunk ROI >= 0.5%, and outside the no-skill band of the published coin-flip simulation
gate_register.register: scripts/gates.py G8 with econ_bar from data/derived/gates_meta.json

gate_register_conflict.what: two existing registers in this repository use the same gate IDs for different rules
gate_register_conflict.resolution: a third, prefixed register IG1..IG9, each threshold attributed to the file it came from, stricter value where they disagree

family.name: Charted first-string quarterback ruled out
family.rule: away club's charted 1st-string QB has Game Status Out or Doubtful on the Wednesday report
family.hypothesis: the market prices a first-string quarterback's absence roughly correctly at closing, so any residual edge must come from the *replacement's* quality, not from the absence
family.note: cannot run before 2026 with the sources in hand: no archived depth chart has been retained for an earlier season, so the trigger is undefined for historical games. Forward-test only.

family.name: Reported quarterback absence without a chart
family.rule: a QB printed Out or Doubtful on the report for either club; the chart is not required
family.hypothesis: the publicly reported absence is over-adjusted once the line has moved to the Wednesday report, so the side losing the QB is worth a small fade at closing
family.note: this is the only injury rule that can be backtested historically today, because it needs no depth chart. It is also the rule the repository already tested without injuries (S8 'Backup-quarterback fade'), so a second claim on it inherits that family's multiplicity.

family.name: Two or more charted first-string defenders out
family.rule: one club has >= 2 designations in {Out, Doubtful} sitting in the 1st-string column of that club's own published defensive chart; bet the Over on that club's opponent's side of the total
family.hypothesis: front-seven absence moves scoring more than the market prices by Saturday night
family.note: needs the unit of every reported row. Today 23 of 139 captured rows have no unit because no captured page defines codes like DE, T and G - counted on the coverage page, and a gate this rule cannot pass until it is closed.

family.name: Second string forced onto the field at cornerback
family.rule: a club's 1st-string CB is Out and the name printed next to him is a player whose own report row is also a designation, i.e. the depth chart is thin at that slot
family.hypothesis: depletion concentrated in one position group is not the same as depletion counted across the roster, and a roster-count feature would wash it out
family.note: the joining rule for this one is unforgiving: report and chart disagree on player name form (Kevin Byard vs Kevin Byard III), so the join runs on the URL slug and needs an ID to be trustworthy at scale.

family.name: Designation count as a proxy (deliberate negative control)
family.rule: bet against the club with more rows printed in the report, regardless of what those rows say
family.hypothesis: none - this rule is here to fail. A count of listed players mostly counts how many players a club chose to put on the page, and the repository's own capture shows most listed rows carry a blank Game Status
family.note: a negative control earns its place by being predicted to fail; if it 'works', the feature is measuring reporting behaviour, not football.

family.name: Blank Game Status is not health (measurement control)
family.rule: no bet. Publishes the count of captured rows whose Game Status cell is empty
family.hypothesis: a model that maps 'no designation' to 'available' silently invents information
family.note: this is a gate, not a strategy: it exists so that a future run fails loudly if someone starts filling blanks with zero.

family.name: Same-game spread + total double
family.rule: F02 fires on the spread leg; the total leg is taken only if the same fixture also fires a total rule, both settled at the same closing prices
family.hypothesis: two injury-driven legs in one fixture share the same cause, so their joint win probability is not the product of the two
family.note: this repository already measured the same-game spread x total dependence at phi = +0.0086 (95% CI -0.0162 to +0.0332) against a parlay that needs phi >= 0.0975 at -110 - see data/derived/corr_same_game.csv and corr_meta.json. A correlated-by-hand parlay does not become a priced edge by adding a second leg.

family.name: Two-leg cross-game injury parlay
family.rule: the two strongest F02 triggers of a given week, different fixtures, both at closing
family.hypothesis: cross-game legs are near-independent, so a parlay is a *worse* bet than the two singles unless one of the two carries a real edge
family.note: published as a documented way to lose vig twice, unless IG3-IG9 pass for both legs first.

family.name: Player-prop combination off a depleted secondary
family.rule: when a club's 1st-string CB is Out, the opposing 1st-string WR's reception-over line is the target; a same-game QB completion leg may be combined only if the two legs' correlation is measured, not assumed
family.hypothesis: bookmakers adjust the team line for an absent cornerback more reliably than they adjust the individual matchup number
family.note: prop prices have no official publisher and are not in the pinned dataset this repository uses, so this rule is defined and cannot be settled here. Blocked by inputs, not by effort.
